description: CloudScope Video lets you play videos directly inside Power BI reports—fully driven by your data. Show the actual footage behind your metrics without sending users to external links. What is this visual? A data-bound video player for Power BI. Each row or selection can display its own video, with optional titles, thumbnails, and tooltip fields. Who is it for? Operations, QA, and compliance teams Sales, product, and demo teams Training, customer success, and enablement teams Marketing and media asset reporting Why use it? Add visual proof and context to KPIs Keep viewers inside the report—no external links Increase engagement and reduce explanation time Key features Single-video or gallery view Supports MP4, WebM, OGG, MOV Poster images, titles, and tooltip data Works with Power BI filtering and interactions Licensing note A license is required for all users who view a report containing this visual. Licenses are available on AppSource. Direct licensing is available for Embedded or Publish-to-Web scenarios.
